verdict.rationale: Ledgy's documented programmatic surface covers only authentication (`auth`) and read operations (`companyCaptable`, `companyTransactions`). Grant automation is described only as an in-app, few-clicks workflow. Nothing in the evidence shows an API that can create draft securities, or any board-approval queue that agent-drafted grants could land in.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, an agent can draft securities (e.g. option grants) via the platform's programmatic surface and leave them queued for human board approval
